effects.name: Swift
effects.notes: Five five-pointed stars in a loose spread, each spinning at its own rate, tiny sparkle trails.

effects.name: Body Slam
effects.notes: Downward speed lines, a big squashed comic impact star, impact lines, dust billows thrown out both sides.

effects.name: Shock Ring
effects.notes: Two broken, uneven shock rings on the floor kicking up dust (a ring by design).

effects.name: Fire Ball
effects.notes: Flame-bodied fireball: hot core, tongues streaming back, embers and smoke shed. Ember-size variant: fire-embers.

effects.name: Embers
effects.notes: Ember: four small separate fireballs with short flickering tails, low formation.

effects.name: Flamethrower
effects.notes: Wedge-shaped jet: narrow at the mouth, wide at the target, wavy edges, yellow-white core line; engulfs the target.

effects.name: Fire Blast
effects.notes: Five-armed star of flame bursts from a white-hot core, flash, then flickers down shedding embers and smoke.

effects.name: Fire Spin
effects.notes: Flame tongues circle the target on a tilted ellipse and rise, front half over the body (trap loop).

effects.name: Flame Wheel
effects.notes: Flame Wheel: a wheel of fire forms around the caster, which charges into the target leaving a fire trail, then bursts into flame with embers. Caster-attached: move the caster by rush.dashPx.

effects.name: Water Jet
effects.notes: Aqua Jet: the caster wraps itself in water and lunges at the target - 4-frame wind-up, dash with a water stream and droplets behind it, splash and spray fan on contact. Caster-attached: move the caster by rush.dashPx.

effects.name: Hydro Cannon
effects.notes: Hydro Pump: pressure build, then a thick translucent stream (8-14 px) with foam running along the top, droplets peeling off, splash crown and water running down at the target; breaks into falling drops.

effects.name: Water Gun
effects.notes: The small water move: a narrow dotted stream of drops, specks shed off, quick, small splash at the end.

effects.name: Bubble Shot
effects.notes: Cluster of 7 bubbles (3-10 px) wobbling forward at different rates, small ones trailing. Pair with Bubble Pop.

effects.name: Bubble Pop
effects.notes: Bubbles arrive and pop one after another: broken ring flash, 3-5 falling droplets each.

effects.name: Surf Wave
effects.notes: A wave arrives (curved crest, white foam, dark-to-light body), then crashes over the target in foam and spray, leaving a puddle.

effects.name: Whirlpool
effects.notes: Water vortex on the floor around the target: translucent spiral arms with foam crests, churning rim wall, flung drops.

effects.name: Razor Leaf
effects.notes: Five leaf shapes (centre vein, lit side, dark edge) in a staggered arc, each tumbling flat-to-edge.

effects.name: Petal Dance
effects.notes: Pink and white petals burst out of the target in a swirl, then flutter down swaying and turning.

effects.name: Sleep Powder
effects.notes: Soft cloud of tiny pale-green powder grains sprinkled over the target, twinkling specks, slow drift down.

effects.name: Leaf Storm
effects.notes: Real leaf shapes (and a few petals) ride a rising helix around the target, tumbling.

effects.name: Electro Ball
effects.notes: Thunder Shock shot: small round crackling ball, short jagged arcs leaping off it every frame, sparks hop behind.

effects.name: Thunderbolt
effects.notes: Thin zig-zag bolts thrown at the target from the upper left, three quick strikes with flashes, then crackle on the body.

effects.name: Thunder
effects.notes: Storm cloud darkens the top, a thick branching bolt falls from above and re-strikes, a disc of light and ground arcs spread.

effects.name: Thunder Wave
effects.notes: Thin gold hoops and a small crackle fly from the user to the target, then jagged static rings close around the target and squeeze (paralysis).

effects.name: Ice Shards
effects.notes: Icy Wind: four faceted crystals in a loose wedge, spinning so the facets swap light and dark; snow specks peel off.

effects.name: Ice Beam
effects.notes: Crisp straight pale beam with star glints; crystals grow on its path, stay, then fall; shards and flakes burst at the target.

effects.name: Ice Break
effects.notes: Target sealed in a faceted ice block, cracks run, it bursts into spinning crystal chunks that bounce and glint.

effects.name: Blizzard
effects.notes: Driving snow in three depth layers on a hard diagonal wind, wind streaks, gust bands, frost on the floor.

effects.name: Vacuum Wave
effects.notes: Punch of compressed air: rigid edge-on pressure rings growing as they travel, speed lines, dust.

effects.name: Mega Punch
effects.notes: A big glove drives in with speed lines, lands with a white comic contact star and hit-lines, pulls back; dust at the feet.

effects.name: Karate Chop
effects.notes: An open hand sweeps down across the target, leaves a curved white slash line for 2 frames, then a small contact star.

effects.name: Focus Energy
effects.notes: Upward flame-shaped energy shell hugging the body, inward rush lines in pulses, ring at the feet.

effects.name: Sludge
effects.notes: Three glossy purple globs in a heavy arc, wobbling, a sticky strand between them, drips beading off and falling.

effects.name: Acid Splat
effects.notes: Goo slaps the target and flattens, droplets fly on heavy arcs, strings drip, a puddle spreads with popping bubbles.

effects.name: Poison Gas
effects.notes: Billowing cloud of round see-through lobes over the target, purple with a sickly green tinge, wisps curling off.

effects.name: Mud Ball
effects.notes: Lumpy brown clod with pebbles, tumbling, shedding crumbs of dirt that drop away; no glow.

effects.name: Earthquake
effects.notes: Three jolts: a web of dark fissures spreads from under the target, rock chips pop up, dust rolls along the floor.

effects.name: Dig Burst
effects.notes: The floor bursts open: hole with a dirt rim, a fountain of clods, a dust cloud with form rolling out and up.

effects.name: Air Slash
effects.notes: Wing Attack / Razor Wind: two pale crescent air blades, wind curls off the tips, a feather tumbling behind.

effects.name: Gust
effects.notes: Wind curls sweep in from the attacker side and wrap around the target, carrying leaves and dust; dust at the base.

effects.name: Twister
effects.notes: Funnel of broken wind lines widening upward, rocks, leaves and dust orbiting, dust churning at the base.

effects.name: Psybeam
effects.notes: A band of tall rings travels a sine path, colours cycling pink/violet/blue/gold; ripples collapse at the target.

effects.name: Psychic
effects.notes: Wavy concentric ripples pulse out from the target in three beats, the air over it bends, pink motes and glints.

effects.name: Mind Field
effects.notes: Two wavy rings counter-rotate around the unit, shimmer lines rise inside, motes drift up.

effects.name: Bug Buzz
effects.notes: Vibrating sound arcs whose edges zig-zag every frame, expanding and thinning, with buzz ticks.

effects.name: Pin Missile
effects.notes: Five thin needles (pale shaft, dark tip, green fletch) fly straight and fast in a staggered burst.

effects.name: Twineedle Hit
effects.notes: Two needles jab in and quiver, white contact puffs, a small purple poison puff bubbles up; needles drop.

effects.name: Infestation
effects.notes: Little insects with flicking wings circle the target on looping paths, in front and behind.

effects.name: Rock Throw
effects.notes: One big faceted boulder tumbling, cracks on it, speed lines, pebbles and a dust puff peeling off.

effects.name: Rock Slide
effects.notes: Four angular boulders fall onto the target one after another, bounce, dust and chips; the pile crumbles.

effects.name: Stone Edge
effects.notes: Angular stone blades burst up around the target in sequence with chips and dust, hold, crack and crumble.

effects.name: Shadow Ball
effects.notes: Dark swirling orb: near-black core, purple swirl arms inside, thin pink rim (the only bright part), smoke trailing.

effects.name: Night Shade
effects.notes: Purple fog creeps, the target is tinted dark violet, ghostly flames rise, slanted eyes open above it, pink orb flash.

effects.name: Spirit Wisps
effects.notes: Three will-o'-wisps with curled tails drift around the unit (Confuse Ray / Curse).

effects.name: Dragon Rage
effects.notes: String of pearls: round blue-violet flame puffs in a line, head biggest, yellow sparks; flame burst at the target.

effects.name: Dragon Burst
effects.notes: Blue-violet flame burst with angular draconic shards spinning out and yellow sparks (Dragon Rage hit / Outrage).

effects.name: Dragon Dance
effects.notes: A serpentine ribbon of blue-violet energy coils up around the unit with flame tufts on its spine.

effects.name: Night Slash
effects.notes: A dark band flicks across, then three black claw gashes with pale lilac rims rake the target and shrink away.

effects.name: Dark Pulse
effects.notes: Rings of malice travel from the user to the target: dark bands with pale spiky leading rims, growing; a dark spiky burst at the target.

effects.name: Malice Orb
effects.notes: Spiky black ball whose spikes grow and retract, pale lilac rim, tight pulsing ring, dark shreds trailing.

effects.name: Flash Cannon
effects.notes: Light gathers at the mouth, then a wide hard-edged silver beam with a specular stripe, metal flakes, white star at the target.

effects.name: Metal Clang
effects.notes: Silver strike arc, two-frame white star clang, a shower of orange sparks off metal arcing down and bouncing.

effects.name: Iron Spikes
effects.notes: Thin mirror-shaded steel blades shoot up in sequence, a glint runs up each, then they retract cleanly.

effects.name: Iron Tail
effects.notes: One heavy polished-metal arc swings down with motion smears, clang star and orange sparks.

effects.name: Moonblast
effects.notes: Pale pink full-moon disc with soft craters and a lit rim, sparkles orbiting and trailing.

effects.name: Charm Burst
effects.notes: Soft pink ring pops, hearts burst out and float up wobbling, 4-point sparkles twinkle (Disarming Voice / Charm).

effects.name: Moonlight
effects.notes: Crescent moon above the unit, a see-through column of moonlight, sparkles circling the feet.

effects.name: Hit Spark
effects.notes: Tackle contact: small white-yellow 5-point star, 4 flick lines, 400 ms.

effects.name: Critical Hit
effects.notes: Two-beat crit: big jagged burst, then a second pop.

effects.name: Crit Cut-in
effects.notes: Opaque screen plate with tapered speed lines for a few frames on crits and K.O.s.

effects.name: Miss
effects.notes: After-images slide off, dust, MISS pops.

effects.name: Shield Dome
effects.notes: Broken shimmering barrier edge, hex glints, motes sliding along it.

effects.name: Heal
effects.notes: Plus glyphs and sparkles rise.

effects.name: Stat Up
effects.notes: Chevrons and streaks flow up.

effects.name: Stat Down
effects.notes: Chevrons and streaks sink.

effects.name: Burn
effects.notes: Small flames and embers on the body.

effects.name: Poison
effects.notes: Purple bubbles rise off the unit and pop, drips, a sickly puddle at the feet.

effects.name: Paralysis
effects.notes: Tiny bolts and sparks, off-beat every third frame.

effects.name: Sleep
effects.notes: Z glyphs drift up and grow.

effects.name: Freeze
effects.notes: A faceted see-through ice shell over the lower body, a glint sweeping across, frost specks.

effects.name: Confused
effects.notes: Three tiny stars circle above the head with trails.

effects.name: Faint Vanish
effects.notes: Dust puff and rising motes; play over the faint animation.

effects.name: Level Up
effects.notes: Light flash, rising streaks and stars, LV UP stamp.

effects.name: Evolve Glow
effects.notes: Silhouette beats white faster and faster in rising light, ends in a flash.

effects.name: Recall Beam
effects.notes: Jittering red beam; unit turns red, shrinks and lifts away in motes.
moves: return to the ball (not a move)

effects.name: Send-out Burst
effects.notes: Light flash and stars bursting as a unit appears.

effects.name: Charge Up
effects.notes: Streaks spiral into a flickering core with growing light.
moves: Solar Beam / Sky Attack / Skull Bash charge

effects.name: Idle Bob
effects.notes: Breathing squash/stretch, blink.

effects.name: Attack Lunge
effects.notes: Crouch wind-up held 7f, dash 2f with smear ghosts, contact freeze 4f, recover.

effects.name: Hit Recoil
effects.notes: 3 white frames, 3 frozen frames, knockback with shake, blinks, settle.

effects.name: Faint
effects.notes: Wobble, flatten, dissolve.
